text: These are also the proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied:
For it is better that it be said to you, "Come up here," Than for you to be placed lower in the presence of the prince, Whom your eyes have seen.
Or he who hears it will shame you And the rumor about you [and your action in court] will have no end.
Like a city that is broken down and without walls [leaving it unprotected] Is a man who has no self-control over his spirit [and sets himself up for trouble].
